breaches.title: More campaign sends are needed for a qualified rate score
breaches.detail: Bounce, complaint, and engagement rates remain visible, but they do not affect the score or automated sending caps until the 30-day cohort reaches 1,000 successful campaign sends.
breaches.suggestion: collect a larger successful campaign-send sample
